tooling.message:
fix(site): on touch, a workshop box keeps the tool and what it does for whom in one card

## Intent

On touch devices the explanation sat under the box, after a dividing line, and read as part of the next box.

## Key changes

- On touch, each box is one card: the link with title and technology, then what the part does for the person and the agent. No dividing line.
- The desktop keeps the hover.
